title: File-based agent project management
titleZh: 基于文件的 Agent 项目管理
summary: Analysis capsules, notebook decisions, dependency boundaries, and handoffs for continuing agent-assisted research.
summaryZh: 按轮次组织分析目录，在 Notebook 中保留判断，用输入边界和交接定位 Agent 要继续的研究。
ownership: I directed and reviewed the changes to my project workflows; Codex implemented the files and helped check them.
ownershipZh: 我提出并审查工作流的修改，Codex 完成文件实现并协助核对。

title: AIQuant
summary: A Codex-assisted research workflow connecting reusable Skills, continuous market data, controlled experiments, and a dashboard. No promotion-ready strategy.
summaryZh: 用 Skills、持续行情、受控实验与网页，把 Codex 的每轮量化研究接起来。目前没有可晋级策略。
ownership: I set the research requirements, choose the next investigation, and review the results. Codex helps implement the tools, research sources, and diagnose problems. This is research; live trading and order APIs remain disabled.
ownershipZh: 我提出研究要求、选择下一步并审查结果，Codex 协助实现工具、查资料和排障。项目处于研究阶段，实盘和订单接口未启用。
details: I set the research requirements and review the results; Codex helps implement, investigate, and diagnose. Scheduled runs should leave a test, a useful finding, or a specific missing input for the next session.

Skills separate event research, source-aware news intake, frontier methods, strategy validation, and data/compute procedures. Compact file packs preserve analysis and unresolved questions without putting the market archive into model context.

An existing background collector writes hot data; research consumes it and refreshes derived outputs. Long histories and large reports live remotely. Chart IQ helps inspect prices, strategy status, and limited registered-service controls.

Experiments keep a frozen strategy definition across historical, account, and execution stages. A 319-reference-trade order-flow diagnostic was near break-even before assumed costs and negative after costs; it remains reused OOS with unverified fills. Live trading and order APIs are disabled.
detailsZh: 我提出研究要求并审查结果，Codex 协助实现、查证与排障。每轮工作要留下检验、有用认识或具体的数据缺口，让下一次能接着做。
Skills 分别保存事件研究、新闻增量收集、前沿方法、策略验证与数据计算的流程。轻量文件包区分已有分析和待查问题，无需把整份行情塞进模型上下文。
后台采集写入近期热数据，研究任务消费已有数据并更新派生报告；长历史和大报告放在远端。Chart IQ 用于查看价格、策略状态，以及受控范围内的后台任务。
历史、账户和执行阶段使用冻结的同一策略定义。一项 319 笔参考交易的订单流诊断，零成本接近盈亏平衡，计入成本后为负；它是重复使用的样本外窗口且未验证成交。实盘和订单接口未启用。

title: BioFlow: omics collection and standardization
titleZh: BioFlow：组学数据采集与标准化
summary: A data-curation workflow for a virtual-cell corpus: interpret heterogeneous files, link cells to samples, and recover metadata through tools and focused model judgments.
summaryZh: 为虚拟细胞语料整理公开组学数据：判断异构文件、对应细胞与样本，再用规则和模型补齐元信息。
ownership: A project I worked on at Guangzhou National Laboratory. I shaped the workflow and later requested isolated omics extensions and Skill-based stage organization; Codex assisted with implementation and debugging. AnnData, Scanpy, and other libraries supply their own components.
ownershipZh: 我在广州国家实验室参与的项目，围绕受约束流程设计，后续提出隔离扩展组学与按 Skill 拆分阶段的要求，Codex 协助实现和排障。AnnData、Scanpy 等库提供各自组件。
details: The initial three-month assignment aimed to replace manual collection and curation; that goal is distinct from measured automation coverage.
I moved from autonomous loader editing toward an explicit workflow, then narrowed ATAC classification context to GSM summaries after user feedback.
File-tree planning, sample mappings and source-specific metadata enrichment address different decisions. A saved reference comparison checked field-value sets, not per-cell or end-to-end accuracy.
RNA, ATAC and spatial data have separate routes; other modalities use file collections first. Nova/Sentinel long-running execution remains a partially implemented prototype.
detailsZh: 最初三个月任务以替代人工收集整理为目标；目标与实际验证范围分开。
从自由修改loader转向显式工作流，实际使用反馈又推动ATAC判断改为读取GSM摘要。
文件树读取计划、样本映射、分来源补metadata分别处理不同关系；保存的参考对照统计字段取值集合，不是逐细胞或端到端准确率。
RNA、ATAC与空间数据分别构建；其他类型先保存文件集合。Nova/Sentinel长期执行仍为部分实现的原型。

links.label: Early public scripts · 早期公开脚本

title: Hermes / local Qwen
periodZh: 个人实践 · 2026 年 8–9 月
summary: A personal setup using self-hosted Qwen with Hermes: tool compatibility, reasoning routes, auxiliary requests, and context configuration.
summaryZh: 把自托管 Qwen 接入 Hermes 的个人实践：工具兼容、推理分档、辅助请求和上下文配置。
ownership: I directed model migration, selected the main and approval routes, and reviewed configuration changes with Codex. Hermes, Qwen, and llama.cpp are third-party components.
ownershipZh: 我提出模型迁移要求，选择主任务与审批路由，并与 Codex 核对配置改动。Hermes、Qwen 和 llama.cpp 均为第三方组件。
details: I tried Hermes after seeing a Qwen demonstration, using Codex for migration, routing, and configuration. The framework, model, and inference runtime are third-party components.
Four aliases shared one model. Later routing logic considered the active task and newest tool batch, allowing routine successful execution to return to Standard.

Historical checks returned structured tool requests once per alias; a separate Hermes terminal trace executed pwd and returned its result. These are minimal compatibility checks, not long-task benchmarks.

September settings used local Standard for main work and an independent Codex approval model, with 262144 context declarations and loop hard stops. This was hybrid inference. Current configuration has changed; the article describes the historical setup.
detailsZh: 看到 Qwen 配合 Hermes 的演示后，我通过 Codex 尝试服务迁移、路由与配置。框架、模型和推理运行时均为第三方组件。
四个别名共用一份模型。后来的路由代码按当前任务和最新一批工具结果判断，让普通成功调用可以回到 Standard。
历史小测中，每个别名各一次返回结构化工具请求；另一次 Hermes 终端测试实际执行 pwd 并回传结果。它们属于最小兼容检查，不是长任务基准。
9 月配置用本地 Standard 做主任务、独立 Codex 模型做审批，补齐 262144 上下文登记并开启循环硬停止，属于混合推理。当前配置已经变化，文章讲当时的实践。

title: Private local workbench
summary: A private Web workbench connecting orders, local scripts, browser execution, progress, and archiving.
summaryZh: 将订单、本地脚本、浏览器执行、进度与归档接在一起的私有 Web 工作台。
roleZh: 通过 Codex 开发的个人工具
ownership: I shaped the workflow, chose the layout and Stop behaviour, and reported failures from use. Codex helped implement and check the changes.
ownershipZh: 我提出工作流要求，选择布局和停止方式，并在使用中反馈故障；Codex 协助实现与检查。
details: Carries the selected order into execution, with queries, stage-level feedback, manual handling, and archiving in the same workbench.

Uses selection versions, execution IDs, and query sequences to keep old responses and previous attempts out of the current view. Stops wait for a local acknowledgement; external requests already sent still need readback.
Separates source and configuration examples from private runtime data, business records, and earlier prototypes. I chose the workflow and interface behaviour; Codex helped implement and check it.
The article includes actual interface components replayed with synthetic read-only data. It does not claim a measured completion rate or current end-to-end production acceptance.
detailsZh: 从选中订单进入执行，在同一工作台完成查询、分阶段反馈、人工处理与归档。
用页面选择版本、执行标识与查询序号区分旧响应和不同尝试；停止等待本机回执，已经发出的外部请求仍需回读结果。
源码与配置示例、私有运行资料、业务记录及旧原型分开存放。我提出工作流与界面要求，Codex 协助实现和检查。
文章配图是实际界面组件的只读合成数据重放；未宣称自动完成率或当前生产全流程验收。

title: Private iPhone workbench
summary: A private iPhone client for managing server tasks, with native workflow pages and explicit budgets for remote browser work.
summaryZh: 用 iPhone 管理服务器任务的私有客户端，结合原生流程页面、远端浏览器与明确的资源预算。
roleZh: 通过 Codex 开发的个人工具
ownership: I set the mobile workflow, page hierarchy, memory and window-management requirements, and reported failures from use. Codex helped implement and check the app; SwiftUI, SwiftNIO SSH, and Chrome are third-party components.
ownershipZh: 我提出移动工作流、页面层次、内存与窗口管理要求，并在使用中反馈故障；Codex 协助实现和检查。SwiftUI、SwiftNIO SSH 与 Chrome 是第三方组件。
details: Native pages expose account information, inputs, execution progress, follow-up work, and order management. The phone and Mac use the same cloud task queue; server work can outlive the phone view.

Ordinary queries reuse HTTPS modules. Browser tasks run serially in the worker, reuse registered windows, and park unneeded processes while retaining profiles. Resource limits are configuration values, not measured footprints.
A file-backed encrypted paging prototype was withdrawn after its storage dependency was reviewed. A swap allowance does not create backing storage or make disk space equivalent to RAM.

The article retains an actual early simulator form with synthetic inputs. Current device installation, smooth dragging, sustained operation, and complete business workflows require separate acceptance.
detailsZh: 原生页面展示账号、资料与参数、执行进度、后续处理和订单管理。手机与 Mac 共用云端任务队列，服务器任务可以继续运行。
普通查询复用 HTTPS 模块；worker 串行运行任务，复用已有窗口，停放不用的浏览器并保留 profile。资源上限是配置值，不是占用实测。
一个基于文件的加密分页原型在核对存储依赖后撤回。Swap 使用额度不会创建后备存储，磁盘也不能与 RAM 等同相加。
文章保留实际早期模拟器的测试表单图。当前设备安装、拖动流畅度、长期运行与完整业务流程分别验收。

title: Image Reconstruction Through Multiple 1D Approximations
titleZh: 多重一维近似图像重建
summary: My master’s thesis explores image reconstruction through multiple one-dimensional projections, interpolation, and sample selection under a fixed representation budget.
summaryZh: 硕士论文研究在固定表示预算下，怎样通过多个一维投影、插值与采样选择重建图像。
ownership: I conducted the thesis research and comparisons. Sampling choices that failed are part of the story, alongside the successful settings.
ownershipZh: 我完成论文研究与比较。失败的采样方案和有效的设置一样，都是这项工作的组成部分。
detailsZh: 同一10,240点、128方向设置下，贪心选点PSNR为25.72 dB，随机采样为19.96 dB；边缘和空间分散先验反而下降。
比较点数、方向数、线性与spline插值，以及选点方向和重建方向的衔接。
高预算时优于普通网络和两种传统对照；Fourier-feature网络整体更强。表示规模不等于实际运行成本。
details: At 10,240 samples and 128 directions, greedy selection reaches 25.72 dB versus 19.96 dB for random sampling; edge and diversity preferences hurt.
Experiments compare sample and direction counts, linear and spline interpolation, and the relationship between selection and reconstruction directions.
At the largest budget, the method exceeds a plain network and traditional baselines; the Fourier-feature network remains strongest. Representation count does not establish runtime efficiency.

title: Sample Time and Cell Pseudotime
titleZh: 样本时间与细胞拟时序
summary: An early study of age-associated expression beyond cell-state changes: trajectory selection, overlapping states, binned comparisons, and inspectable model baselines.
summaryZh: 从轨迹选择与状态覆盖入手，比较基因表达沿样本年龄和拟时序的变化，再尝试残差回归、NAM与VAE。
ownership: I worked on preprocessing, trajectory analysis and model comparisons. This preceded SCage / TempoFactor; sample-time associations do not identify environmental causes.
ownershipZh: 我参与预处理、轨迹分析和模型比较。这是SCage / TempoFactor的前序研究；样本时间关联不等于微环境因果。
details: Compared pseudotime and sample-age patterns while checking branch selection and state coverage.
Explored polynomial residual regression, binned stability scores, NAMs, and a covariate-supervised VAE.
Sparse overlap and correlated time axes limited factor identification; the later task narrowed toward sample-time prediction.
detailsZh: 比较拟时序与样本年龄两条轴，先检查分支选择、预处理和共同状态覆盖。
尝试多项式残差回归、分箱稳定性评分、NAM与协变量监督VAE。
状态覆盖不足及两轴相关限制因素识别，后续任务收紧到样本时间预测。

title: SCage / TempoFactor
summary: A sample-time-aware VAE studied through stage prediction, conditional gene readouts and spatial follow-up.
summaryZh: 从样本时间监督的VAE出发，研究阶段预测、条件化基因读出和组织中的空间关联。
ownership: I contribute to reproduction, model refactoring, benchmark checks, gene attribution and figures in this team project. The study remains ongoing.
ownershipZh: 我在团队项目中参与复现、模型重构、对照检查、基因归因和图表分析；研究仍在继续。
details: Separates Shared and Time representations while retaining a joint count-data reconstruction model.
A fetal-lung reproduction exposed different holdout units and unequal query-data access across baselines.
Conditional gene aggregation changed reference recovery; an analogous scVI readout performed closely. Spatial results remain local associations.
detailsZh: 将Shared与Time分开读出，并共同重建计数表达；两个生物因素是否真正分开仍需验证。
胎肺复现区分donor与stage留出，核对不同基线的查询数据访问差异。
条件化汇总改善当前参考基因恢复，同读出scVI接近；空间结果保留为局部关联。

title: Neural Fields for Spatial Transcriptomics
titleZh: 空间转录组的 Neural Field 探索
summary: Coordinate-based expression modeling exposed a useful failure: fitting observed points well did not guarantee interpolation across sparsely observed slices.
summaryZh: 基于坐标的表达建模留下了一个有用的失败：已观测点拟合得好，并不保证跨稀疏切片的插值可靠。
ownership: I reimplemented a coordinate-to-latent pipeline and compared models. SUICA, STINR and other reference methods belong to their original authors.
ownershipZh: 我重实现了坐标到 latent 的流程并比较模型。SUICA、STINR 等参考方法属于原作者。
detailsZh: 从二维点位表达重建扩展到三维切片，比较MLP、Fourier网络、SIREN及归一化变体。
重写GAE→低维表示→坐标网络→解码器流程，分阶段对齐表示与调整表达输出。
二维拟合与切片间预测分开评价；原型编码器访问验证表达，不作为完全不可见切片测试。梯度不等于细胞移动或命运。
details: Extended two-dimensional expression modeling to three-dimensional sections, comparing MLP, Fourier networks, SIREN, and normalized variants.
Reimplemented a GAE-to-latent-to-coordinate-network pipeline with staged alignment and decoder adjustment.
Distinguished fitting from between-section prediction; encoder access to validation expression limits the prototype evaluation. Gradients do not establish movement or fate.

title: Bona: YOLO training and visual control
summary: YOLO experiments on a 2080 Ti, a self-collected game dataset and real-time control, followed by PyTorch adaptation and YOLOv5 training on Ascend.
summaryZh: 2080 Ti 上的 YOLO 消融训练、自采游戏数据与实时控制，以及华为比赛中的昇腾适配和 YOLOv5 训练。
ownership: I worked on company-data training experiments, collected and labeled game data, compared capture methods and used ONNX/TensorRT. The prototype built on YOLOv7 and team code.
ownershipZh: 我做公司数据上的训练实验，自采和标注游戏数据，比较截图方式并使用 ONNX/TensorRT；原型基于 YOLOv7 与团队代码。
details: Structure/loss ablations and training-budget choices on a single 2080 Ti; no robot-hardware deployment.
An enemy/teammate dataset, model-assisted labeling and further capture, plus capture and inference latency work.
A separate real-time control prototype; later Huawei competition training on Ascend via a YOLOv5 template after compatibility problems.
detailsZh: 单张 2080 Ti 上的结构/损失消融与训练预算取舍，未部署机器人硬件。
敌人/队友标注、自采与模型预标注循环，以及截图和推理延迟的比较。
实时控制原型；后参加华为比赛，昇腾适配遇兼容问题，改用 YOLOv5 模板训练。

title: Bus Equity
period: Fall 2023 · BU Spark × Livable Streets Alliance
periodZh: 2023 年秋 · BU Spark × Livable Streets Alliance
summary: Client analysis of bus commute disparities in Massachusetts: mapping regional reversals and comparing pandemic-era gaps with the earlier trend.
summaryZh: 为 Livable Streets Alliance 分析马萨诸塞州公交通勤差距：用地图找出地区差异与方向反转，比较疫情后的差距和此前趋势。
ownership: I led the regional-analysis question and participated in the wider analysis and client presentation.
ownershipZh: 我负责地域差异分析，并参与整体分析与客户汇报。
details: ACS five-year data, annualized commute hours, and geographic comparisons across 2016–2021 PUMA areas.
The team delivered regional maps, trend and regression analysis, and planning recommendations; the findings do not establish pandemic or policy causality.
detailsZh: 使用 ACS 五年数据，统一年通勤小时口径，比较 2016–2021 PUMA 地区的群体差异。
团队交付地区地图、趋势与回归分析及规划建议；这些结果不能直接识别疫情或政策的因果作用。

title: Data Days for Good
summary: A four-day survey-analysis project delivered as an R Shiny report. I focused on cleaning comments, grouping sentiment, and extracting frequent words; readers can explore questions and demographic groups.
summaryZh: 四天内把学生体验问卷做成 R Shiny 交互报告。我重点处理评论清洗、情绪分组与组内高频词，报告支持自选问题和背景群体。
ownership: I contributed comment analysis and visualization to a shared survey-report product.
ownershipZh: 我参与评论分析与可视化，和团队共同交付问卷报告。
details: The report connects survey context, written findings, and self-service question/demographic controls.
2024 received 1,088 responses, with 895 retained under the completion rule. Question-level denominators differ; current group-percentage output requires reconciliation with its instructions.
detailsZh: 报告把调查背景、已有解释和自助问题／群体筛选接在一起。
2024 原始 1,088 份，按完成度规则保留 895 份；逐题分母不同，当前部分群体比例输出仍需与说明核对。

title: Sneaker trading prototype
summary: An individual database course project: a handwritten browser-driven scraper, MySQL schema, Django ORM, and adapted shop templates. Payments remained unfinished.
summaryZh: 独立完成的数据库课程项目：手写浏览器爬虫、设计 MySQL 表、用 Django ORM 连接功能，逐页修改商店模板；支付尚未接入。
ownership: I completed the course application on my own, using Django, scraping libraries, and an existing Bootstrap shop template.
ownershipZh: 我个人完成课程应用，使用 Django、爬虫库与现成 Bootstrap 商店模板。
details: I wrote the Selenium/BeautifulSoup scraper; the saved catalog contains 7,084 records.
Products, seller inventory and sold-item records are separated; Django ORM connects them to catalog and order pages.
I gradually adapted existing frontend templates. I recall the main application as largely assembled, with payments unfinished; the old purchase flow has not been revalidated.
detailsZh: 手写 Selenium/BeautifulSoup 爬虫，现存目录保存 7,084 条商品记录。
区分鞋款、卖家库存和已售记录，用 Django ORM 连接商品及订单页面。
当时不会做前端，逐页修改现成模板。本人回忆主要系统已基本搭建，只差支付；旧购买流程未重新验证。

title: EMRNet: multi-stage image restoration
summary: An MPRNet-based exploration of ACA, SAB, SCAM, activations and normalization, reflecting on structural changes whose problem-level rationale remained insufficiently established.
summaryZh: 以MPRNet为基线尝试ACA、SAB、SCAM、激活函数和归一化；回顾结构改动的动机，以及未充分从具体问题原理出发论证的不足。
ownership: I worked on the EMRNet modifications. The multi-stage foundation, ORSNet and baseline feature-fusion design come from MPRNet.
ownershipZh: 我围绕EMRNet进行结构改动；多阶段骨架、ORSNet和基线特征融合设计来自MPRNet。
details: Retained a three-stage restoration architecture, with encoder-decoder processing followed by an original-resolution branch.
Explored adjusted channel attention (ACA), decoder spatial attention (SAB) and supervised channel attention (SCAM), along with Mish, Swish and Instance Normalization.
The retrospective explains design and evaluation choices without quoting unverified improvement percentages.
detailsZh: 保留三阶段恢复结构：前两阶段编码解码，第三阶段在原分辨率处理。
尝试ACA通道注意力、解码器SAB空间注意力与SCAM监督通道注意力，以及Mish、Swish和Instance Normalization。
文章解释设计与评价取舍，不引用无法核对的提升百分比。

title: Mental-health chatbot
summary: A counseling QA prototype connecting data collection, topic classification, response generation, and reader evaluation.
summaryZh: 连接咨询问答采集、主题分类、回答生成与人工评估的 NLP 原型。
ownership: I participated in this undergraduate project. The report and presentation are jointly authored; the results describe the project experiments.
ownershipZh: 我参与了这项本科项目；报告与演示共同署名，文中的指标来自项目实验。
details: Collected counseling QA text, used a bidirectional LSTM for topic classification, and compared an encoder–decoder Transformer with a 345M-parameter DialoGPT model.
Reader evaluation had 37 valid submissions: DialoGPT scored higher on quality but lower on appropriateness.
detailsZh: 从咨询问答文本出发，用双向 LSTM 做主题分类，比较编码器—解码器 Transformer 与 345M 参数的 DialoGPT。
人工评价得到 37 份有效反馈：DialoGPT 的整体质量更高，适切性评分却更低。

title: PhD advisor screening
summary: A personal research tool for working through university directories, professor pages, research fit, and recruitment information.
summaryZh: 从学校院系目录出发，整理教授名单、个人主页、研究匹配和招生信息的个人研究工具。
role: Workflow design and development with Codex
roleZh: 需求与流程设计、Codex 协作开发
ownership: I specified and iterated this personal tool with Codex. It uses third-party browser and model tools; roster coverage and page review are tracked separately.
ownershipZh: 我提出需求并与 Codex 迭代这个个人工具；浏览器和模型使用第三方工具，名单范围与主页核查分开记录。
details: Started with a Notebook and modular Python pipeline; evolved toward official unit rosters, per-person page review, and resumable CSV tasks.
A saved BU run remained incomplete despite 1,424 records. A later HKUST(GZ) AI/DSA roster merged 35 and 34 unit memberships into 65 people, retaining four cross-appointments and homepage gaps.
detailsZh: 从 Notebook 和模块化 Python 原型，逐渐转向学校实际院系名单、逐人读主页与 CSV 分步续跑。
BU 的一次保存结果虽有 1,424 条记录，仍未完成全范围；后来港科广 AI/DSA 名单将 35 与 34 条学域归属合并为 65 人，保留 4 位跨聘和主页缺口。

title: Android ticket-tool research
titleZh: 票务工具与 Android 自动化调研
summary: A reading of open-source ticket tools to understand Android control paths, page state, latency boundaries, and result confirmation.
summaryZh: 阅读几份开源票务工具，理解安卓控制链路、页面状态、计时范围和结果确认。
ownership: A personal investigation of third-party projects: WECENG/ticket-purchase, Guyungy/damaihelper, and currycan/HaTickets. Their implementations are credited in the article.
ownershipZh: 个人工具调研，讨论 WECENG/ticket-purchase、Guyungy/damaihelper 与 currycan/HaTickets 的第三方实现，文章保留原作者链接。
details: Traced the Appium client/server/Android-driver path and the separate Python uiautomator2 entry used by HaTickets.
Compared element lookup, page-state detection, timing boundaries, and how return values are checked before reporting an outcome.
detailsZh: 梳理 Appium 客户端、服务端与 Android 驱动的关系，对照 HaTickets 使用的 Python uiautomator2 入口。
从源码比较控件定位、页面状态、计时范围，以及结果返回值如何用于判断一轮操作是否完成。

title: Stardew Farm Blueprint
summary: A local tile-based farm plan with three construction stages, entrance checks and a rule-based next-action list.
summaryZh: 把农场改造拆成三个阶段，用格子坐标表达建筑与道路，检查出入口，再生成下一步建设清单。
ownership: I set the two-player farm requirements and revised the layout with Codex-assisted implementation. Game and Stardew Planner art belong to their creators.
ownershipZh: 我提出双人农场的需求与改图判断，Codex协助实现。游戏与Stardew Planner素材保留原作者归属。
details: Separates sprite bounds, ground footprints and entrance offsets on an 80×65 Canvas grid.
Checks modeled occupancy, roads, fields, reserves and entrance access using BFS to a road tile.
Three fixed stage layouts and manual-state action rules; no measured in-game profit/time gain or global optimization claim.
detailsZh: 在80×65格的Canvas上，分别记录建筑图片、地面占地与入口位置。
检查建模范围内的重叠、道路、农田、预留地，并从门口搜索到道路。
三套阶段方案配合手填状态的规则清单；尚无游戏内收益/耗时对照或全局最优证明。

title: Texas Equity
summary: A web and SwiftUI poker calculator for random-deal equity, player-count comparisons and faster card entry.
summaryZh: 从网页到 SwiftUI，计算随机对手下的牌局权益，解释人数与平分的影响，并改进手机输牌。
ownership: I defined the requirements and iterated on an iPhone 13 Pro. Codex assisted implementation; web replay and native source are described separately.
ownershipZh: 我提出功能需求，并用 iPhone 13 Pro 反复调整操作和布局，Codex 协助实现。网页演示与原生源码分别描述。
details: Samples legal deals without replacement, evaluates seven-card hands, and splits tied equity by the number of winners.
Separates draw-hit probability, an approximate post-improvement equity view, and hand-category distributions.
Continuous and text card entry; native background tasks reject stale results. Random opponent hands, no range model or optimal betting policy.
detailsZh: 无放回模拟合法牌局，比较七张牌中的最佳牌型，并按共同获胜人数分摊权益。
分别展示听牌命中率、补强后的近似权益与牌型分布，避免把几个概率混为一谈。
连续选牌与文本输入；原生计算任务防止旧结果覆盖。对手为随机手牌，未实现范围建模或最优下注策略。

title: STS2 MCP on Mac
titleZh: Mac 上的杀戮尖塔 MCP
periodZh: 个人接入实践 · 2026 年 3 月
summary: Setting up CharTyr’s STS2-Agent on macOS, fixing a missing manifest copy, and testing a state-first playing loop.
summaryZh: 在 macOS 接入 CharTyr 的 STS2-Agent，补齐身份清单复制，并实际验证每步重读局面的出牌流程。
roleZh: 第三方工具接入与使用
ownership: CharTyr created the framework. I requested and checked the Mac setup and playing workflow; Codex assisted implementation and actions. The build-script patch remains in the local working copy.
ownershipZh: 框架由 CharTyr 开发。我提出并核对 Mac 接入和游玩流程，Codex 协助实现与操作；构建脚本补丁留在本地。
details: Historical Mod 0.5.2/game v0.99.1 health check and six completed actions across two turns, followed by a user interruption.
Refreshes hand/target indexes and waits for a new action window; legal actions do not establish playing strength.
Removed Mod files with a backup; retained enable settings and separate modded saves were identified. A successful return to vanilla was not verified.
detailsZh: 历史健康检查为 Mod 0.5.2 / 游戏 v0.99.1；两回合中完成六次动作，之后由本人中断。
重新读取手牌与目标索引，并等待新的可操作阶段；可执行不等于策略优秀。
移走 Mod 并保留备份，定位残留启用设置和独立 Mod 存档；未验证最终切回普通档。

title: Stardew pixel-bead patterns
summary: Character cutouts, real bead-code charts and color counts, with a palette correction that restored a skin-colored shirt to white.
summaryZh: 把游戏人物整理成透明图、实际色号孔位表与用量统计，并修正一次把白衬衣映射成肤色的错误。
ownership: I specified size, pixel detail, shadow removal and Artkal codes, then reviewed the palette. Codex implemented the scripts; game character art belongs to its creators.
ownershipZh: 我提出尺寸、像素细节、去影子和 Artkal 色号要求，并检查配色；Codex 实现脚本，游戏人物形象归原作者。
details: Preserves each occupied pixel as a bead cell; the two 15×31 patterns contain 392 and 333 filled cells.
Hand-written C-code mappings and AppKit chart rendering; color-count tables come from the cell data.
Three prepared patterns and existing PNG outputs; no physical color-match or assembled-craft validation.
detailsZh: 以一像素对应一孔保留轮廓，两个 15×31 图案分别有 392、333 个非空孔位。
用手工整理的 C 系列颜色对应表和 AppKit 输出孔位图，从同一网格统计各色数量。
已整理三个人物图案及 PNG；屏幕配色仍是近似，未验证实物成品与色差。

title: AStockQuant research notes
periodZh: 个人研究 · 2026 年 6 月
summary: A small A-share data workflow with filing-event alignment and a fixed price-volume ranker; neither baseline established a usable strategy.
summaryZh: 接入小样行情与公告，检查事件对齐和固定权重量价排序；两条基线均未形成可用策略。
roleZh: Codex 协助的数据与信号研究
ownership: I specified the data source and storage approach and challenged the data/test scope. Codex implemented the workflow, with a-stock-data, Qlib and QuantMind as third-party references.
ownershipZh: 我提出数据来源、存储要求并追问数据与测试范围；Codex 实现流程，a-stock-data、Qlib 与 QuantMind 为第三方参考。
details: 16-stock price sample: 28,703 bars, with 5,344 filings covering nine stocks.
238 eligible filing rows represent 211 stock-and-return intervals; title-rule results remain weak.
Fixed five-feature ranker, not trained Qlib/LightGBM; no promoted strategy or live execution.
detailsZh: 16 只股票共 28,703 行行情；5,344 条公告覆盖其中 9 只股票。
238 条可用事件对应 211 个股票—交易区间，标题规则的表现较弱。
五特征固定权重排序，未完成真实 Qlib/LightGBM 训练，无晋级策略或实盘执行。

title: ComfyUI video experiments
period: Personal use and workflow adaptation · August 2026
periodZh: 个人使用与流程适配 · 2026 年 8 月
summary: Two saved H3 clips, a memory-mode diagnosis on an A6000 and a three-segment workflow adaptation that remained unvalidated.
summaryZh: 两段 H3 视频输出、一次 A6000 显存模式排查，以及尚未验证成片的三段连续工作流适配。
role: Using and adapting existing workflows with Codex
roleZh: 借助 Codex 使用与适配现成流程
ownership: I supplied reference photos, directed the action/outfit experiments and questioned the memory diagnosis. Codex adapted configurations. ComfyUI, MiniMax H3 and the continuation suite are third-party work.
ownershipZh: 我提供参考图、提出动作和换装需求，并追问显存诊断；Codex 适配配置。ComfyUI、MiniMax H3 和连续视频插件来自第三方。
details: Saved outputs: 15.083-second action clip and 5.167-second outfit test. The latter changed identity and failed the intended task.
Historical process check: 48 GB A6000 with about 30 GB free, launched with --novram and custom nodes disabled.
Prepared a BF16 three-segment configuration; no verified continuous output or controlled acceleration benchmark.
detailsZh: 保存了 15.083 秒动作片和 5.167 秒换装测试；换装结果连人物也改变，未达预期。
历史进程检查：48 GB A6000，近 30 GB 空闲，同时带着 --novram 且禁用自定义节点。
准备了 BF16 三段流程，未验证连续成片，也没有同条件加速对照。

title: Local search MCP for Qwen
titleZh: 本地 Qwen 搜索 MCP
periodZh: 个人工具接入 · 2026 年 9 月
summary: A small search entry point with Bing-first retrieval, DuckDuckGo fallback and explicit engine notices, paired with the existing browser tool.
summaryZh: 用小型搜索入口查候选网页，Bing 优先、DuckDuckGo 回退，并与已有浏览器工具分工。
roleZh: Codex 协助的 MCP 实现与接入
ownership: I identified the lack of useful web discovery and approved a dedicated tool. Codex implemented it using the MCP SDK, Playwright request contexts and Cheerio.
ownershipZh: 我发现模型不主动搜索的问题并同意增加专用工具；Codex 借助 MCP SDK、Playwright 请求上下文和 Cheerio 实现。
details: One callable local_web_search entry point returns titles, URLs, snippets and engine/fallback notices.
Saved tests show a configuration query returning generic pages before the fallback change and official documentation after it.
Search relevance remains heuristic; browser inspection and reliable model tool selection remain separate concerns.
detailsZh: local_web_search 返回标题、网址、摘要和实际引擎/回退原因。
保存测试中，同一配置查询从泛产品页变为回退后的官方文档。
相关性仍是粗略规则；打开正文与模型稳定选择工具仍需分别检查。

title: CN Radar job collection
summary: An Android collection and App-to-Web workflow adapted on top of the open-source CN Company Radar Toolbox.
summaryZh: 基于开源 CN Company Radar Toolbox，适配 Android 采集、App 与网页衔接及完整 JD 整理。
roleZh: 通过 Codex 迭代的个人适配
ownership: The underlying toolbox is an upstream open-source project. I set the collection and review requirements and iterated the Android workflow and handoff with Codex; the upstream product is not my original work.
ownershipZh: 基础工具箱来自上游开源项目。我提出采集与阅读要求，通过 Codex 迭代 Android 流程和数据衔接；保留上游产品归属。
details: Uses visible Android controls for latest-first discovery, and associates expanded descriptions with platform job IDs for library ingestion and Web use.
Keeps card discovery, captured descriptions, coarse field rules, and model review separate. Scripts handle repeatable interaction; model review uses the description and personal project materials.

One historical App batch retained 26 expanded descriptions with distinct job IDs. The article uses a cropped actual App capture; no recruiter information, private application records, or communication is published.
detailsZh: 通过 Android 可见控件发现最新排序的候选，将展开的 JD 与平台岗位 ID 对应，进入岗位库并衔接网页。
卡片发现、正文采集、字段粗筛和模型评阅分别记录。脚本处理重复交互，模型结合 JD 与个人项目资料判断。
一轮历史 App 采集保存了26份不同岗位 ID 的展开正文；配图为裁切后的实际 App 画面，不公开招聘者信息、私人投递记录或沟通内容。

title: Rental radar adaptation
periodZh: 个人适配 · 2026 年 9 月
summary: A small adaptation of Zuche Radar for returning availability, same-period quote comparisons, and Web-based monitoring controls.
summaryZh: 基于开源神州车型雷达，补充返场车源、同租期报价比较和网页监控设置。
roleZh: 需求设计与 Codex 协助的局部适配
ownership: Built on LuckinSven's open-source Zuche Radar. I defined the stock-change and comparison requirements and iterated the local additions with Codex.
ownershipZh: 基础应用来自 LuckinSven 的开源神州车型雷达。我提出车源变化和比较需求，通过 Codex 迭代局部功能。
details: Distinguishes a model first entering the library from a known model becoming rentable again for the same dates.
Compares the lowest available list price only within the same city, model, and exact rental period; location mix and final charges remain separate.
Adds Web controls for rotating rental windows, a compact change list, and a display reset that retains history.
detailsZh: 区分车型首次入库和已知车型在同一租期重新可租。
在同城市、同车型、相同取还时间内比较最低可租列表价；保留网点变化和最终费用的区别。
网页设置轮换查询的租期和周期，收起价格细节，清空已读变化时保留历史。

title: GCP request analysis coursework
titleZh: GCP 请求分析课程项目
summary: A course pipeline that serves cloud-stored files, records generated HTTP requests in SQL, and investigates what two classifiers can learn from them.
summaryZh: 从云存储文件服务到请求入库，再用两项分类实验分析模拟数据中的可学习关系。
ownership: I implemented server integration, request schemas, and model analysis for a sequence of assignments. The course supplied the HTTP client; startup scripts adapt Google sample code.
ownershipZh: 完成连续课程作业中的服务接入、请求表和模型分析；HTTP 客户端由课程提供，启动脚本沿用 Google 示例。
details: Connects Flask file requests with Cloud Storage, logging, Pub/Sub messages, and Cloud SQL request records.
Separates Country, Request, and Request_fail, with explicit limits on what missing fields and fallback attributes can support.

Saved outputs show 100% country classification and 12.23%/12.60% income classification on generated data. Prefix mappings and independently sampled eight-class income labels explain why those tasks differ.
detailsZh: 用 Flask 连接 Cloud Storage 文件读取、运行日志、Pub/Sub 消息和 Cloud SQL 请求记录。
拆分 Country、Request 与 Request_fail，检查缺字段和默认值对后续分析的影响。
模拟数据上的国家分类输出100%，收入分类输出12.23%/12.60%；前缀映射和独立随机的八类收入解释了两项任务的差异。

title: ROC and model evaluation notes
periodZh: 课程练习 · 2023 年 9 月
summary: A short course-based explanation of confusion-matrix rates, operating thresholds, and limits of statistical fairness claims.
summaryZh: 围绕课程练习，解释混淆矩阵的分母、工作阈值，以及统计公平指标的适用范围。
ownership: The assignment supplied the questions and diagrams. My notebook contains the confusion-matrix implementation, metric calculations, and written answers.
ownershipZh: 题目和示意图由课程提供；notebook 包含我的混淆矩阵实现、指标计算和书面回答，按课堂笔记展示。
details: Uses an actual course matrix to distinguish Recall, FPR, and Precision through their denominators.
Separates one operating point from a complete ROC curve and discusses threshold costs.
Connects the course fairness questions with primary research on deferral and sources of harm, without claiming a new fairness method or empirical audit.
detailsZh: 用实际题图解释 Recall、FPR 与 Precision 的分母差异。
区分一个工作点与整条 ROC，并讨论阈值选择的代价。
结合延后决定与偏差来源的原始研究解释课程问题，不声称新公平算法或实证审计。
